title: Fishers of Men

scenes.title: Put Out into Deep Water
scenes.note: Matthew 4 and Mark 1 tell of Jesus calling these fishermen by the Sea of Galilee. Robertson's Harmony treats Luke 5:1-11 as the same event; some scholars think it was a second time.

bsb: Put out into deep water and let down your nets for a catch.
kjv: Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

bsb: we have worked hard all night without catching anything. But because You say so, I will let down the nets.
kjv: Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.

puzzle.prompt: Simon had caught nothing all night. What happened when he did what Jesus said?

choices.text: So many fish that the nets began to tear

puzzle.hint: Listen to what happened to the nets and the boats.

bsb: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees.
kjv: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying,

bsb: for I am a sinful man.
kjv: Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

bsb: For he and his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken, and so were his partners James and John, the sons of Zebedee.
kjv: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon.

bsb: From now on you will catch men.
kjv: Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.

bsb: Put out into deep water and let down your nets for a catch.
kjv: Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

puzzle.hint: One of them is a fisherman who felt sorry for his sins.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the synagogue, Jesus commanded an evil spirit to leave a man, and it obeyed Him.

bsb: Let us go on to the neighboring towns so I can preach there as well, for that is why I have come.
kjv: Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.

puzzles.prompt: Put Jesus' day in Capernaum in order.

events.text: The whole town gathers at the door at sunset
Jesus prays early in the morning

puzzles.hint: The day began in the synagogue on the Sabbath.

puzzles.prompt: Tap Capernaum, the fishing town where Peter lived.
puzzles.hint: Capernaum is on the north shore of the Sea of Galilee.

bsb: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”
kjv: Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

bsb: I will make you fishers of men.
kjv: I will make you to become fishers of men.

reflect: Peter did what Jesus said even when it didn't make sense, and then he left everything to follow Him.
discuss: Peter had fished all night with nothing. Why do you think he obeyed Jesus anyway?
What do you think it means to “catch men” or be a “fisher of men”?
Even when everyone was looking for Him, Jesus got up early to pray. Why was prayer so important to Him?
prayer: Jesus, help us trust You like Peter did, and follow You wherever You lead. Make us fishers of people. Amen.
